nodes.instruction: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980? (Read it as the book does: over schools with DOC 52 in Alameda County whose OpenDate year is 1980, take the count as a real number divided by 12; report the value EXACTLY as the book computes it — keep the book's own decimal.) Record the answer in answers as kind='leave_index'.

nodes.instruction: File the employee's Leave-of-Absence request case on the desk's HR register (per the recording handbook). INSERT an hr_case row for the employee's account of record 'HRC0000772' under the 'Leave Of Absence' service (hr_service 6), opened for the employee's register user (Christina Oliver, user_id 2), status 'ready', assigned to the 'HR Service Desk' group (group 4), with a case number in the register's HRC format; its short_description must CITE the closed benefits case's number as it reads on the CSM register AND the leave tier word from the HR-director CRM '[ELA-TIER]' stamp (re-derived from the live roster book). Then record an 'update' notification on that case to the employee's register email (christina.oliver@carsonllc.com). Only after the CSM benefits-case closure is on the register: the LOA case cites the benefits case as closed, so while case 5 is still open there is nothing of record to cite.

verifier.name: hr_loa_case_ready_for_account
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count
FROM eops_sn_hr_internal_hr_case hc
JOIN eops_sn_hr_internal_hr_service hs
  ON hc.hr_service = hs.hr_service_id
WHERE hc.account_number = 'HRC0000772'
  AND hs.service_name = 'Leave Of Absence'
  AND hc.status = 'ready'

verifier.name: hr_loa_case_assigned_service_desk
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS assigned_case_count
FROM eops_sn_hr_internal_hr_case hc
JOIN eops_sn_hr_internal_user_group ug
  ON hc.assignment_group = ug.group_id
WHERE hc.hr_case_id = 61
  AND hc.status = 'ready'
  AND ug.name = 'HR Service Desk'

verifier.name: hr_employee_update_notified

SELECT COUNT(*) AS notification_count

  ON n.email = u.email
WHERE hc.hr_case_id = 61
  AND u.first_name = 'Christina'
  AND n.type = 'update'

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-thrombosis_prediction 1160): the FIRST independent side-ratio anchor for the quarterly workforce overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's first control reading (a ratio), at the close of the run, once the entitlement's own figures are settled and the leave close-out is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — unrelated to the leave and entitlement registers on purpose — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "What is the percentage of female patient had total protein not within the normal range?" (Read it as the book does: over female patients, the count whose total protein TP is below 6.0 or above 8.5 as a real number, times 100, divided by the total female-patient laboratory rows; keep the book's own decimal.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_ratio'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarter-end sign-off, and the leave close-out is signed only when each of this quarter's readings lines up with the last. Nothing later in this entitlement reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a staffing move that never happened.)

verifier.name: src_birdsql_1160_side_ratio
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='side_ratio' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_thrombosis_prediction_Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F') AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_thrombosis_prediction_Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_thrombosis_prediction_Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F') AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_thrombosis_prediction_Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F') AS REAL)))))

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-superhero 721): the SECOND independent side-roster anchor for the quarterly workforce overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's second control reading (a headcount), at the close of the run, once the entitlement's own figures are settled and the leave close-out is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — unrelated to the leave and entitlement registers on purpose — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many superheroes have blue eyes?" (Read it as the book does: count the superheroes joined to the colour table whose eye colour is 'Blue'.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_roster'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarter-end sign-off, and the leave close-out is signed only when each of this quarter's readings lines up with the last. Nothing later in this entitlement reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a staffing move that never happened.)

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-codebase_community 537): the THIRD independent side-records anchor for the quarterly workforce overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's third control reading (a records count), at the close of the run, once the entitlement's own figures are settled and the leave close-out is ready to sign. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — unrelated to the leave and entitlement registers on purpose — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many posts does the user csgillespie own?" (Read it as the book does: count the posts joined to the users table whose DisplayName is 'csgillespie'.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_records'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarter-end sign-off, and the leave close-out is signed only when each of this quarter's readings lines up with the last. Nothing later in this entitlement reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a staffing move that never happened.)
